entries.title: Faculty future activation and site Change Log
changes: Faculty Lookup: add a new Faculty member, set a future activation date, and distinguish Pending Start from manually inactive staff.
Calendar and Teaching Assignments: prevent assignments before the Faculty member's activation date while allowing eligible future sessions.
Add a large Change Log window on the PAWS homepage with an Open button and a Close button.
Require every future PR to describe its updates in the Change Log; agents must follow the repository rules and CI validates the record.
These features use synthetic browser-local Testing data; no live SQL or Firestore records are modified.
